lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Mn5O4 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 44-atom unit cell (Li8Mn20O16) and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mn in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Li adopts an octahedral environment with three Li and three O neighbors. The O-centered environments are three- or four-coordinate, linking Mn and Li. Validated polyhedron contacts show corner-sharing between Li and Mn octahedra, and edge-sharing between Mn octahedra, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
